subject: Preferred billing lane change & PO header lock — request for early invoices
messages:
From: Helen Grant <h.grant@careplushealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Preferred billing lane change & PO header lock request

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — quick procurement ask as we close the books for the quarter. Our AP team is running a year-end audit and would like to change the billing lane for the Redwood account to a monthly invoice cadence for the next two quarters. Specifically: we need invoices that match our PO header (cost center, BU code, and PO number) and a firm PO header lock so our ERP can auto-map invoices into the right ledgers.

Two constraints from our side:
- Net terms: we prefer Net45 for this cadence.
- Discount: given the change in cadence and our volume, procurement will consider a ~2% early-pay discount if Redwood can issue invoices monthly and include the PO header lock.

Attached is our PO template (CarePlus_PO_Template_2026.pdf) with the required fields. Can Redwood support a temporary billing-lane change and PO header lock? If there are pricing or packaging implications please flag them — we’re open to a short call today.

Thanks,
Helen Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager
CarePlus Health
(h.grant@careplushealth.com)


--
Attachment: CarePlus_PO_Template_2026.pdf (pdf)
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Helen Grant <h.grant@careplushealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-20T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Preferred billing lane change & PO header lock request

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear note and the template. Quoting your key asks below for context:

> Our AP team is running a year-end audit and would like to change the billing lane for the Redwood account to a monthly invoice cadence for the next two quarters.
> 
> Net terms: we prefer Net45 for this cadence.
> 
> Discount: procurement will consider a ~2% early-pay discount if Redwood can issue invoices monthly and include the PO header lock.

Short answer: we can support a monthly cadence and map the PO header fields you’ve called out, but there are three items we need to align on before we can lock that in operationally:

1) PO header lock: our billing system can enforce a required PO header on incoming invoices if Finance enables the "PO-header lock" flag on the account. That requires a signed amendment to the standard SOW or a purchase order that references the Redwood deal_id (CPH-2026-0893).

2) Net terms & discount trade-off: our default hosted pricing uses Net30. Based on the options we can offer:
   - Option A: Net45 + 2% early-pay discount (monthly invoices) — standard approval path (sales + finance sign-off).
   - Option B: Net60 with no discount — requires a credit check and finance approval; slower to enable.
   - Option C: Quarterly advance invoice (one invoice for three months up-front) + 4% prepay discount — operationally simpler for mapping but requires AP to accept advance billing.

3) Invoice format and split: to preserve mapping, please ensure each invoice contains the PO number and cost center on every line item. If CarePlus needs split invoices (e.g., multiple internal POs per month), note each split will appear as a separate invoice in our system — that’s fine, but we’ll need the mapping rules clearly listed in the attached Redwood_Invoice_Routing_FAQ.docx.

Next steps I propose:
- If you prefer Option A (Net45 + 2%), I’ll loop in Finance (Vivek) for a quick approval and Legal for a one-line amendment referencing the PO template.
- If you prefer Option C (quarterly advance + 4%) we need a signed DocuSign amendment before the first advance invoice.

I’ve attached our invoice routing FAQ and a sample invoice export. Happy to jump on a 20-min call today at 11:30 PT if that helps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Routing_FAQ.docx (docx)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Grant <h.grant@careplushealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-20T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Preferred billing lane change & PO header lock request

Hi Helen — thanks for sending over the PO template. Quick note from the commercial side: we can be flexible on discounts if CarePlus commits to a 12-month cadence at the agreed billing lane. Practical offer we can approve today (pending Vivek’s finance sign-off):

- 3% discount on Net45 if CarePlus commits to 12 months of monthly invoicing and includes the PO header on each invoice.
- 2% discount if this is a temporary (2-quarter) change.

Camila — we can escalate to 3% if the customer signs a 12-month billing commitment; otherwise, 2% for two quarters is our baseline. Helen — would you be open to a 12-month billing lane commitment? If so, I’ll prepare amendment language for Legal.

—Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Helen Grant <h.grant@careplushealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-20T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Preferred billing lane change & PO header lock request — Finance approval (temp)

Hi Helen, Camila, Vanessa —

Finance reviewed the ask and we can approve a temporary change to monthly billing cadence for two quarters with the following conditions:

1) Term: Temporary change for Q1–Q2 2027 only unless CarePlus signs a 12-month billing commitment.
2) PO header lock: AP must provide a signed purchase order that references deal_id CPH-2026-0893 and includes the cost center field on each invoice line. Once we receive that PO we will enable the PO-header lock flag on your account.
3) Net terms & discount: We approve Option A with a slight revision — Net45 with a 2.5% early-pay discount for the temporary two-quarter arrangement. If CarePlus signs a 12-month commitment we will convert to 3.0% as Vanessa proposed.
4) Attachments/format: Please use the provided CarePlus_PO_Template_2026.pdf and ensure the PO number appears in the invoice header and every line item. We also need AP to include the ERP cost center code in the PO body (example: CC-7741).

Once we have the signed PO and confirmation of the chosen discount option, Legal will issue a one-line amendment and Billing will flip the account to monthly cadence and lock the PO header.

I’m attaching a short settlement memo draft for internal ops (Settlement_Memo_Draft.pdf). Camila — if Helen confirms this plan, please share the signed PO and I’ll push the enablement ticket to Billing.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
